cancellationPolicies.label: Deposit Only rates
cancellationPolicies.description: This property has a 1 day cancellation policy. Failure to cancel within this time will result in a cancellation charge equal to the first night of your stay, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information).

*Age restriction 18-35 yrs old only*
This deluxe mixed dorm has brand new bunk beds with your own privacy curtains and reading light, 2 of your own personal security lockers, full air conditioning / heating, full en-suite bathroom.

paymentProcedure.label: Deposit only
paymentProcedure.description:
Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.

specialEventConditions.title: New Years 2025-26
specialEventConditions.description:
/!\ NEW YEARS EVE 2025/2026 /!\

Holiday Reservation Policy (December 22, 2025 - January 5, 2026)
To ensure a smooth experience during the peak holiday season, please take note of the following special reservation conditions:
Full Prepayment Required: All reservations made for stays between December 22, 2025, and January 5, 2026, must be fully prepaid at the time of booking.
Failed Payment: If the payment is unsuccessful or not completed, the reservation will be automatically cancelled.
Minimum Stay Requirement: A minimum stay of 5 consecutive nights is required for bookings within this period.
Any stay during this period has a free cancelation up to 60 days before the check-in, after this period, the full amount will be kept.

Restricted Check-in/Check-out Dates:
No check-ins or check-outs are allowed on December 25th, 31st, 2025, and January 1st, 2026.
Please plan your travel dates accordingly.

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 29th Dec 2025 (AEDT) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 29th Dec 2025 (AEDT) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
